entities.summary: Barney Bubbles was an English graphic artist whose work encompassed graphic design and music video direction. Bubbles, who also sketched and painted privately, contributed to the design practices associated with the British independent music scene of the 1970s and 1980s. His record sleeves featured symbols and riddles. Barney Bubbles was a authors & novelists from Whitton (1942-07-30, Whitton–1983-11-14). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
